status: Selected source reviewed; exact AST preservation and all 24 paired runtime transparency checks passed before the registered full development intervention audit.

interventions.predictive: Slow/fast concentration and expert-weight adaptation runs; learned mixture predicts occupancy and feeds the existing route/lookahead planner.
interventions.frozen: Disable _learn before both forgetting and evidence updates; raw slow[9], fast[9], log_weights[3] remain initial. Mapping, localization, visible-state inference, visits, targets and forecasting continue.
interventions.no_planning: Continue learning and exporting learned forecasts, but recompute all route risks and lookahead hazards using uniform attempted-movement probabilities in the same planner; this is uniform-law prediction, not removal of all prediction.
interventions.frozen_no_planning: Combine concentration/weight freeze with uniform-law route and lookahead forecasts.

predictive_adaptation.updates: Anonymous occupied-set likelihood under uniform/slow/fast experts; expected directional responsibilities respecting blocked attempts; information-weighted concentration updates and likelihood-tempered expert weights.
predictive_adaptation.forgetting: Slow/fast concentrations relax toward0.65/0.35 priors with retention0.985/0.86 on every enabled step, including steps without admitted likelihood. Log weights update only for admitted likelihoods; skip likelihood across25-step wall-phase boundaries.
predictive_adaptation.mixture: Fixed12% uniform plus88% expert-weighted mixture; initial effective law is uniform. Frozen parameters are episode-initial values, not post-learning values.
predictive_adaptation.update_counter_limit: Source counters measure informative slow-expert sources/effective information. Raw parameter changes also include forgetting and expert-weight normalization; counts alone do not establish new dynamics information.

state_separation.localization_mapping: Public displacement updates position; terrain, seen times and inferred boundaries accumulate from observations. These routines do not read learned parameters.
state_separation.occupancy_inference: Reset visible source masses at current occupied cells and reconstruct fresh diffuse hidden Poisson intensity every forecast. No persistent hidden-density filter or inferred enemy identities.
state_separation.controller_memory: Target/target_kind, visits and map/observation history remain active in all conditions. Planner only writes target/target_kind; those fields are not read by predictive updates or forecasts.
state_separation.anonymous_limit: One source per observed occupied cell approximates unknown multiplicity when enemies overlap.

forecast.target: At least one enemy occupies a coordinate after the next enemy tick.
forecast.coordinates: Grid coordinates relative to initial agent position, accumulated from public displacement.
forecast.action_conditioning: Assumes interaction=True, including opening a cardinally adjacent door when holding both keys. Enemy law is independent of the chosen movement. All selected and immutable-memory actions interact=True.
forecast.unknown_terrain: Observed/memorized walls and inferred boundaries block; unobserved terrain is treated as traversable for enemy propagation. Blocked attempted probability stays; no legal-only renormalization.
forecast.hidden_model: Diffuse intensity over unseen remembered/local candidate cells, density=(3-visible occupied cells)/max(45,130-free visible cells); not normalized to a fixed remaining enemy count.

planner.route: Static route edge cost1+16*horizon1 occupancy+visits+known occupied-cell penalty. A route cost reusing this field is not a calibrated future path-collision probability.
planner.hazard_event: For coordinate q at lookahead stage t, enemy occupies q before OR after enemy tick t. Visible-source overlap correction before+after-before*stay; hidden intensity uses an analogous Poisson union.
planner.conditioning: Stages2/3 remain unconditional marginal hazards; they are not conditioned on survival along earlier proposed positions. Door geometry is the initially forecast open/closed state rather than branch-specific future interactions.
planner.control: Three-stage dynamic program with fixed stage weights1,0.55,0.25, deadline-dependent risk multiplier55..100, route potential and step/wait/visit costs. Excludes visible occupied immediate destinations.
planner.immediate_comparability: At an admitted immediate destination, before occupancy is zero and all possible predecessors are observed; actual stage1 hazard equals corresponding next-tick occupancy for the same law. Validate independently from public geometry. Exported learned occupancy can differ from risk used under the uniform-law intervention.

instrumentation.ast_proof: All original top-level algorithm nodes are structurally identical after removing one observer call placed after action computation and before return. Original export function preserved under a wrapper.
instrumentation.observer: Copies already computed actual planner choices, scores, hazards, continuations, current law, route target, risk weight and local hazard fields into a diagnostic-only memory key. Copies raw predictive parameters during export. No additional forecast rollout or random draw.
instrumentation.public_planning_fields: diagnostic_planning: occupancy_horizon1_local, collision_hazards_local[1..3], choices, selected move, position, target, target_kind, risk_weight, future_weights and law. Law is inferred or uniform; no hidden environment probabilities enter ordinary candidates.
instrumentation.actual_risk_validation: Independent immediate occupancy reconstruction from visible sources/public blocked geometry; compare to actual captured stage1 hazards and original exports. Reconstruct each choice score from recorded continuation, observed visit counts and hazard. Check chosen action equals argmin of actual captured score/hazard/potential/move tuple.
instrumentation.resource_limit: Observer adds serialization/computation overhead under unchanged worker limits; frozen assessment must retain invalid executions.

passive_replay.same_memory_experience: Selected online/frozen shadows may run WM/export only on immutable-memory public observations and preceding recorded actions. No planner or environment step runs in the shadow.
passive_replay.independence_argument: Only target/target_kind are written by planner; neither is read by WM, _learn, _combined_law, _forecast or original export. last_action is unused. The memory policy always interacts=True, matching forecast geometry.
passive_replay.runtime_verification: Source-independent common observations/labels and raw freeze state will be checked by the shared five-shadow helper. Failure fallback retains every forecast target and episode; no on-policy trajectory match required for these shadows.

lineage_snapshot.source: native lineage and gen4 sampling record
lineage_snapshot.scope: Selected is a direct original-seed child on birth island0, with no inspirations. This is not a gen1 descendant or the handwritten comparator.

limitations: Development audit reuses search cases and is not independent selected-program performance evidence.
Uniform-law substitution retains a predictive planner; do not call it no prediction.
Better on-policy forecast scores do not establish better prediction on identical experience.
A single selected program does not establish reliable discovery across searches.
Forecast hazards and route cost are approximate and are not an optimal-policy bound.
